title: Machine Unlearning in Low-Dimensional Feature Subspace
abstract: arXiv:2601.22456v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine Unlearning (MU) aims at removing the influence of specific data from a pretrained model while preserving performance on the remaining data. In this work, a novel perspective for MU is presented upon low-dimensional feature subspaces, which gives rise to the potentials of separating the remaining and forgetting data herein. This separability motivates our LOFT, a method that proceeds unlearning in a LOw-dimensional FeaTure subspace from the pretrained model through principal projections, which are optimized to maximally capture the information of the remaining data and meanwhile diminish that of the forgetting data. During unlearning, LOFT simply optimizes a small-size projection matrix that can be flexibly inserted into the pretrained model, requiring just one-shot feature fetching from the pretrained model. translated_title: 低维特征子空间中的机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在从预训练模型中移除特定数据的影响，同时保持模型在剩余数据上的性能。本工作从低维特征子空间的视角为机器遗忘提出了一个新颖的研究角度，揭示了在该子空间中分离保留数据与遗忘数据的可能性。这种可分离性催生了我们提出的LOFT方法，该方法通过主投影在预训练模型的低维特征子空间中执行遗忘，这些主投影经过优化，能够最大程度地捕获保留数据的信息，同时削弱遗忘数据的信息。在遗忘过程中，LOFT仅需优化一个小型投影矩阵，该矩阵可灵活地插入预训练模型，且只需从预训练模型中一次性获取特征。LOFT证明了即使无需（重新）……（原文摘要截断），也可以在低维特征子空间中实现有效且高效的机器遗忘。
tldr: 提出LOFT方法，通过在预训练模型的低维特征子空间中优化一个可插入的小型主投影矩阵来分离保留数据与遗忘数据的信息，从而以极低开销实现有效且高效的机器遗忘。
en_tdlr: LOFT achieves effective and efficient machine unlearning by optimizing a small, flexibly insertable principal projection matrix within a low-dimensional feature subspace of the pretrained model, which separates retained data from forgotten data information with minimal computational overhead.
